name: front leg lift under knee tap
description: A standing move where you drive a knee up and tap beneath it with your hands. It warms up the hips and works the abs.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your hands out in front.
Lift one knee up and forward to hip height.
Reach both hands under that thigh and tap beneath the knee.
Lower the foot with control and switch legs.
Keep your chest up and stay light on your feet.
Alternate sides at a steady, bouncy pace.
